objective: Frozen computation: labelled KF3 from every presentation of lines of 5 to 8; per new distinction, the share of information about the bare bracketing carried by the grown states read four ways (unnamed; the line's distinctions named; the order of growth named; all named), and the conditional entropy of the order of growth and of the line's names given the unnamed grown base.
status: Supported 2026-11-18 (refereed R1, confirmed with fixes; 4 of 4 predictions held): the share of the knots' nesting that one grown base's unnamed states miss is a small part of the order of growth (adds 0.07 to 0.49 to the named line), knowing which distinctions are the line's adds 0.005 to 0.30, and the order is mostly undetermined by the states even with the line named (0.9 to 3.9 bits); lines of 5 to 8.
title: Which names carry the nesting, and is the order of growth readable
